name: Haus "Hanni" Gundolf
beschreibung: The inn Haus "Hanni" Gundolf is located in a quiet, rural area of Tirol, nestled in the mountain world of the Alpen. The rooms are kept in typical Tiroler style and equipped with modern amenities. The culinary offering includes regional specialties, which are served in the hotel's own restaurant. Hiking trails and ski slopes are in the immediate vicinity. The personal, family atmosphere contributes to a feeling of well-being. A guest garden with sun terrace invites you to linger.
